How Isar Aerospace launched a rocket from the northernmost spaceport on Earth
The second time this private rocket left the ground from Norway
caption:
A German startup just launched their Spectrum rocket from Andøya Spaceport in Norway, the northernmost commercial launch site on Earth. Their first attempt in 2024 ended before the rocket reached space. This is attempt two.

Isar Aerospace is building what SpaceX built for the US, but for Europe. Small satellites, European rockets, no dependence on anyone else. This launch is a big deal for the continent.
